translated_title: Mexico and France Agree to Insist on Initiative to Limit the Veto in the UN Security Council
original_title: México y Francia acuerdan insistir en iniciativa para limitar el veto en el Consejo de Seguridad de la ONU
author: Iván Evair Saldaña
meta_description: The Franco-Mexican proposal, backed by 120 countries since 2015, would bar the UN's five permanent members from vetoing action on genocide or war crimes.
